provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Denies that the named factor decides the outcome: the factor may vary freely and the result holds anyway (年齢によらず人それぞれだ). It attaches directly to a noun, and typically to one naming a presumed deciding factor (見かけ, 年齢, 印象). Class sibling を問わず instead announces that a condition will not be asked about, and prefers nouns with clear alternatives (男女, 国籍).

examples.ruby: 味[あじ]の好[この]みは年齢[ねんれい]によらず人[ひと]それぞれだ。
examples.english: Taste in food varies from person to person, regardless of age.

examples.ruby: 合否[ごうひ]は面接[めんせつ]の印象[いんしょう]によらず点数[てんすう]で決[き]まる。
examples.english: Pass or fail comes down to the score, not to the impression you make in the interview.

examples.ruby: 祖父[そふ]は天候[てんこう]によらず毎朝[まいあさ]同[おな]じ道[みち]を歩[ある]く。
examples.english: My grandfather walks the same route every morning whatever the weather.

patterns.usage_note: Declares a condition off the table: whichever alternative holds, it makes no difference (国籍を問わず出場できる). It attaches directly to a noun, typically one with clear, enumerable alternatives (男女, 国籍, 経験の有無, 昼夜). It belongs to announcements, job ads and rules rather than casual speech, and is written 〜を問わず. Class sibling によらず points at a would-be deciding factor and denies its influence.

examples.ruby: 当店[とうてん]は経験[けいけん]の有無[うむ]を問[と]わずスタッフを募集[ぼしゅう]します。
examples.english: Our shop is hiring staff, with or without prior experience.

examples.ruby: この大会[たいかい]は国籍[こくせき]を問[と]わず出場[しゅつじょう]を認[みと]めている。
examples.english: The tournament is open to entrants of any nationality.

examples.ruby: 昼夜[ちゅうや]を問[と]わず苦情[くじょう]の電話[でんわ]が鳴[な]り続[つづ]けた。
examples.english: Complaint calls rang in around the clock, day and night alike.
